description: This Java class defines the `FieldType` entity within the OpenMRS project. It extends `BaseChangeableOpenmrsMetadata` and includes properties such as `fieldTypeId` and `isSet`, along with corresponding getters and setters. The class is annotated with `@Audited` for Hibernate Envers auditing and overrides `getId()` and `setId()` methods compatible with OpenMRS object interfaces.

classes.name: FieldType
classes.description: Entity class representing a field type in the OpenMRS data model, with properties for its identifier and a boolean flag indicating if it is a set.

methods.name: getFieldTypeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the FieldType instance.

methods.name: setFieldTypeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the FieldType instance.

methods.name: getIsSet
methods.description: Returns whether this field type is a set.

methods.name: setIsSet
methods.description: Sets the boolean flag indicating if this field type is a set.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the getId method from OpenmrsObject interface, returning the fieldTypeId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the setId method from OpenmrsObject interface, setting the fieldTypeId.
